newsitem.title: USA: Tenn. 1,170 MW Watts Bar nuclear plant cuts output.
newsitem.headline: Tenn. 1,170 MW Watts Bar nuclear plant cuts output.

text.p: Electricity output at the 1,170 megawatt (MW) Watts Bar 1 nuclear power plant in Spring City, Tenn., was reduced to repair a tube leak in its east side water box, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
In Wednesday's daily status report, NRC said the facility was operating at 60 percent power, and reducing production to less than 50 percent for the repair.
The Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) owns and its subsidiary TVA Nuclear operates the Watts Bar 1 plant.
TVA Nuclear declines as a matter of policy to comment on the operation of its power plants.
